title: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: New search experience for Microsoft 365 users without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license
summary: Microsoft 365 is updating the Copilot app's search experience for users without a Copilot license, enabling modern search controls by default starting late November 2026. Users can toggle back to classic search. The update improves file and third-party content search while respecting access permissions.
body:
[What and why]

We are introducing an updated search experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for users with a Microsoft 365 license who do not have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. The updated experience provides modern search controls to help users find, refine, and navigate search results more easily.

[Rollout schedule]

- General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in late November 2026 and is expected to complete by mid-December 2026.- Deferred Release (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in late December 2026 and is expected to complete by mid-January 2027.[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Users with a Microsoft 365 license who do not have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.Platforms and services

- Microsoft 365 Copilot appWhat will happen

- The updated search experience will be enabled by default for users in Standard release tenants.- Users can return to the classic search experience by using the toggle on the search results page.

- With the updated search experience, users can continue to find files using keywords, use modern search controls to refine and navigate results, and search supported connected third-party content when their organization has configured connected sources.- Search results will continue to display only content that users have permission to access.[Action required and recommendations]

We recommend that you:

- Inform users and your help desk about the updated interface and how it differs from the classic search experience.- Explain how users can return to the classic search experience using the toggle on the search results page.[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
bodyHtml:
[What and why]

We are introducing an updated search experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for users with a Microsoft 365 license who do not have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. The updated experience provides modern search controls to help users find, refine, and navigate search results more easily.

[Rollout schedule]

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in late November 2026 and is expected to complete by mid-December 2026.
  • Deferred Release (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in late December 2026 and is expected to complete by mid-January 2027.

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

  • Users with a Microsoft 365 license who do not have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot app

What will happen

  • The updated search experience will be enabled by default for users in Standard release tenants.
  • Users can return to the classic search experience by using the toggle on the search results page.
  • With the updated search experience, users can continue to find files using keywords, use modern search controls to refine and navigate results, and search supported connected third-party content when their organization has configured connected sources.
  • Search results will continue to display only content that users have permission to access.

[Action required and recommendations]

We recommend that you:

  • Inform users and your help desk about the updated interface and how it differs from the classic search experience.
  • Explain how users can return to the classic search experience using the toggle on the search results page.

[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
